identity.title: The ALPINE-ALMA [CII] Survey: Unveiling the baryon evolution in the interstellar medium of z ∼ 5 star-forming galaxies

paper_type_evidence.quote: We refer to (cite: LeFevre20), (cite: Bethermin20), and (cite: Faisst20) for a detailed description of the ALPINE survey, observation and data processing, and the ancillary data, respectively.

question.value: Which processes of gas and dust production, consumption and destruction (outflows, inflows, SN dust, AGB dust, ISM dust growth, IMF) reproduce the observed gas and dust content of 98 ALPINE z~5 galaxies?

evidence.quote: We make use of chemical evolution models to simultaneously reproduce the observed dust and gas content of our galaxies, as obtained from spectral energy distribution fitting and ionized carbon measurements, respectively.

claims.hypothesis: Can chemical evolution models reproduce gas and dust of z~5 galaxies, and does a top-heavy IMF help?
claims.experiment: Fit model grids to CIGALE and [CII]-derived quantities for 98 galaxies with both IMFs
claims.finding: THIMF alleviates the tension, but the youngest dusty sources remain unexplained

evidence.quote: although it is still not enough to reproduce the youngest and dustier sources of our sample

evidence.quote: Despite these variations, the $\mathrm{sM_{Dust}}$ derived for the youngest galaxies remains too large to be reproduced by the current models.
